citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D

schema.Invoice: VARCHAR(20) - Invoice number, 6-digit integer; if starts with 'C', indicates cancellation
schema.StockCode: VARCHAR(30) - Product (item) code, 5-digit integer or alphanumeric code
schema.Quantity: INTEGER - The quantities of each product (item) per transaction
schema.InvoiceDate: DATETIME - The day and time when each transaction was generated
schema.CustomerID: VARCHAR(20) - 5-digit integer customer number; can be null for anonymous guests
schema.Country: VARCHAR(50) - The name of the country where each customer resides

raw_invariance_policy: Immutable. No in-place modification allowed. SHA-256 verified at intake.
